This '''battle''' was the concluding battle of the [[First Great Schism]]. With the [[Legions of Lettow]] crippled after the [[Death/Legends|death]] of their leader, [[Xendor]], and a crushing [[Battle of Columus|defeat]] on [[Columus/Legends|Columus]], the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]], led by [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Awdrysta Pina]], attacked [[Lettow]] in an attempt to finish their opponents off. The Legions, now commanded by Xendor's lover [[Arden Lyn]], knew there was no hope of victory, so they settled for holding the Jedi off until they could escape to refuge beyond the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic's]] borders.<ref name="EGTW" />
